description: Returns upcoming deadlines of open opportunities, ordered by deadline (nearest at the top), with grants and contracts balanced: 20 rows by default, up to 50 with limit, and moreRows giving the remaining count and the next offset. Inputs: days or weeks ahead, an optional single category, limit, offset, and compact (false adds full descriptions and per-section lists). Notices that cannot be bid on, past deadlines and undated rows are excluded. The page is not a complete calendar for the window. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

category.description: One opportunity type only: "grant", "procurement" (contracts) or "prize". When omitted, grants and procurement are returned together as separate sections.

compact.description: Compact rows (default true) keep payloads small; long titles, organizations and links may be shortened or omitted. false returns full descriptions, nested quality details and full section arrays.

days.description: Alternative to weeks: exact number of days ahead to show (default: 28, max: 365; values above 365 are treated as 365).

limit.description: Rows on this page across all sections (default 20, max 50; values above 50 are treated as 50). Without a category the page is split between grants and procurement.

offset.description: Rows to skip in each section, for the next page (default 0). The moreRows.nextOffset of the previous answer gives the value for the next page.

weeks.description: Number of weeks ahead to show (default: 4, max: 52; values above 52 are treated as 52). When days is also set, days applies.
